27886.description:
SPECTRA POM IS HIRING
– 2X LICENSED ELECTRICIANS
!
Spectra Industrial Limited - a Leader in Sales, Service and Hire of Forklifts, Gensets and Industrial Supplies, is seeking two (2) organized, qualified, and well experienced Licensed Electricians to join our POM Workshop Team and be a part of our growing enterprise!
Position Description
Position Title: Licensed Electrician (2 Positions)
Company: Spectra Industrial Limited
Location: Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
Reports To: Operations Manager / Southern Region Manager
Position Purpose
Licensed Electricians will be responsible for installing, testing, diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining electrical systems, wiring, controls, equipment, generators, forklifts, workshop facilities, and site electrical assets to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant operation. Applicants must hold a recognized electrical trade qualification, current PNG electrical license or registration where applicable, and a current PNG driver’s license, with practical experience, strong safety awareness, and the ability to complete electrical maintenance records accurately.
Key Responsibilities
Electrical Installation, Testing
& Preventive Maintenance
Carry out electrical installation, inspection, testing, servicing, and preventive maintenance on workshop facilities, equipment, gensets, forklifts, and related electrical systems.
Perform scheduled and breakdown maintenance in line with company procedures, manufacturer requirements, and applicable PNG electrical and workplace safety standards.
Identify faulty, unsafe, or worn electrical components and recommend timely repair, isolation, replacement, or upgrade.
Electrical
Fault Diagnosis & Repairs
Diagnose faults in electrical circuits, control panels, starters, alternators, batteries, lighting, wiring, motors, and associated systems.
Repair, replace, terminate, and test defective electrical parts and components using correct tools, test instruments, and safe electrical work practices.
Conduct post-repair testing and confirm equipment is electrically safe, functional, and ready for operation before handover.
Tools,
Test
Equipment
& Materials
Care
Use electrical tools, meters, insulation testers, manuals, drawings, and diagnostic equipment correctly and safely.
Maintain tools and test equipment in good working condition and report damaged, expired, or unsafe equipment promptly.
Assist with ordering, collection, and proper use of electrical parts, cables, consumables, and materials.
Safety, Compliance & Housekeeping
Comply with company safety procedures, PPE requirements, lock-out/tag-out requirements, toolbox talks, and Papua New Guinea workplace safety standards.
Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free workshop and work area, especially around live, isolated, or stored electrical equipment.
Report hazards, electrical incidents, unsafe equipment, and non-conformances promptly to the supervisor.
Documentation & Reporting
Complete job cards, inspection checklists, electrical test records, service reports, and maintenance records accurately and on time.
Record parts used, work completed, isolation status, test results, and outstanding repairs clearly for workshop tracking.
Communicate equipment status, defects, risks, and maintenance priorities to supervisors and relevant teams.
Teamwork & Operational Support
Work closely with mechanics, operators, stores, workshop staff, and site teams to meet operational requirements.
Assist apprentices or junior staff with safe on-the-job guidance where required and within company procedures.
Undertake additional duties, training, or site support as reasonably directed by management.
Breakdown & Field Support
Respond to workshop or field electrical breakdowns and carry out repairs efficiently to minimize downtime.
Support site-based electrical maintenance activities where travel, call-out, or roster work is required.
Ensure repaired electrical systems and equipment are safe, tested, compliant, and ready for operation.
Key Competencies & Skills
Electrical fault-finding and diagnostic ability.
Strong safety awareness and compliance with safe electrical work practices.
Attention to detail, workmanship, and accurate testing.
Communication and reporting skills.
Teamwork, reliability, and initiative.
Ability to work under pressure, respond to breakdowns, and meet operational deadlines.
Qualifications & Experience
Minimum Grade 10 education, Grade 12 is an advantage.
Recognized Electrical Tradesman Certificate or equivalent electrical trade qualification from a recognized institution; NATTB-certified trade qualification is highly preferred.
PNG electrical license, registration, or authorization to perform licensed electrical work is required where applicable.
Minimum 3–5 years’ relevant electrician experience in a workshop, commercial, industrial, construction, mining, oil and gas, power generation, or maintenance environment.
Sound knowledge of electrical installation, preventive maintenance, fault diagnosis, repair procedures, isolation, testing, and safe work practices.
Experience working with generators, forklifts, industrial equipment, control panels, motors, batteries, lighting, and workshop electrical systems is highly desirable.
Current and valid PNG driver’s license is required – Class 6 or relevant license will be an added advantage.
Ability to read electrical drawings, manuals, and specifications, complete workshop documentation, and work independently or as part of a team.
Interested in joining our Competitive, Responsive and Committed Team?
Send your updated resumes with contactable referees, trade certificate, electrical license or registration copy, driver’s license copy, and relevant supporting documents, to email:
[email protected]
with “Licensed Electrician – POM” on the subject line.
Applications can also be hand delivered to our Port Moresby branch Office.
Attention: HR Recruitment Team
Spectra Industrial Ltd
P.O. Box 7528
Boroko, NCD
Remuneration will be discussed during the interview.
For all positions we require current and verifiable workplace referees to be provided. Any references and qualifications provided will be verified and checked should your application get to shortlist stage.
Note:
Applications are open to PNG citizens only.
Priority will be given to the POM based applicants.
Former applicants need not re-apply.
Female applicants are encouraged to apply.
Application closes on COB Friday 07
th
August 2026.
Late applications will not be accepted.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

27701.description:
About Newmont
Newmont produces metals the world needs - safely, responsibly and with care for people, communities and the environment. With a 100+ year history, we continue to shape the future of mining through innovation and strong operational performance. By joining our inclusive, world-class team, you can help shape the future of mining and make a meaningful difference.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation is located on Aniolam Island in Papua New Guinea’s New Ireland Province. Lihir is one of the world’s largest producing gold operations, set within a geothermally active, extinct volcanic crater. The operation includes an open-pit mine and complex processing facilities, with a diverse workforce supporting safe, reliable and responsible mining.
Lihir offers a unique opportunity to work in a technically complex mining environment, where electrical safety, statutory compliance, reliability and operational integrity are critical to the success of the site.
Your role
As the Supervisor, Registered Mine Electrician, you will lead site electrical safety, compliance, training and authorisation practices across the Lihir operation.
Appointed by the Registered Mine Manager, this role is responsible for ensuring personnel who operate, work on, or work near electrical apparatus meet site requirements and statutory obligations. You will play a key role in maintaining the safety and integrity of the site electrical system, ensuring compliance with the Newmont Electrical Safety Management Plan, the High Voltage Safety Management Plan, Newmont site standards, and relevant Australian/New Zealand electrical standards.
This role is suited to an experienced Electrical Engineer with strong electrical safety management experience, practical mine or heavy industry electrical knowledge, and the confidence to provide technical authority, guidance and assurance across site electrical activities.
Key Responsibilities
Maintain the safety and integrity of the site electrical system across the Lihir operation.
Ensure site electrical works comply with the Electrical Safety Management Plan and High Voltage Safety Management Plan.
Authorise amendments to the Electrical Safety Management Plan and ensure regular review and effectiveness checks are completed.
Authorise new electrical installations, alterations and personnel for licensed electrical work in line with site requirements.
Maintain site registers for licensed electricians, authorised persons, safety observers and licensed electrical contractors.
Review electrical licences and personnel qualifications to confirm authorisation requirements are met.
Audit electrical workers to ensure they hold the correct competencies for the tasks they are completing.
Review inspection and test records to ensure required testing is completed before approving Notifications of Energisation.
Complete Certificates of Compliance and confirm installations meet AS/NZS 3000 and Newmont standards.
Lead or support electrical safety incident investigations, identify actions and ensure outcomes are implemented and documented.
Report serious electrical incidents to the Registered Mine Manager and meet site reporting requirements.
Provide technical guidance to electrical departments on site electrical specifications, standards and requirements.
Support Management of Change risk assessments for new electrical installations.
Attend punch list walkdowns to confirm new installations and alterations meet Newmont site specifications and relevant Australian standards.
Perform field critical control checks and ensure the workforce follows risk control and isolation processes.
Your Skills & Experience
Electrical Engineering Degree.
Ability to obtain a PNG Power Authority Electrical Licence.
LVR/CPR certification.
Strong working knowledge of AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules.
Detailed understanding of AS/NZS 3007 Electrical installations for mines, AS/NZS 4871 Electrical equipment for mines and quarries, AS/NZS 3012 Construction electrical, and AS/NZS 60079 Hazardous Areas.
Strong knowledge of high voltage safety, HV switchgear and protection systems.
Experience working within electrical safety management systems, high voltage safety management plans and site electrical standards.
Experience authorising electrical personnel, reviewing electrical licences and maintaining compliance records.
Strong incident investigation skills, including the ability to identify actions and ensure they are implemented.
Ability to liaise across electrical, maintenance, engineering, operations and leadership teams to provide technical clarification and guidance.
Strong coaching and communication skills, with the ability to develop team members through feedback, coaching and formal training.
Ability to work within approved budgets, manage variances and identify cost reduction opportunities without compromising safety or compliance.
Desirable experience includes IEPNG membership, PNG MRA Mine Electrician’s Certificate or the ability to obtain them. HV Switching Certificate, EEHA Certification, Radiation Safety Officer Certificate, and previous experience in a statutory electrical role within mining, fixed plant maintenance, high voltage, processing or heavy industrial environments will also be highly regarded.
Work Environment & Benefits
This is a full-time role based at Lihir Gold Limited in Papua New Guinea, with roster arrangements to be discussed. The role may be offered on a 21 days on / 21 days off FIFO roster or a residential full-time 5 days on / 2 days off roster.
You will support Asset Management, Fixed Plant Maintenance, Reliability and Compliance in a technically complex mining environment where electrical safety, authorisation, isolation practices, high voltage controls and compliance with Newmont standards are critical to safe and reliable operations.
You will work closely with site leadership, electrical departments, maintenance teams, operations teams and contractors to ensure electrical work is completed safely, legally and in line with Newmont standards.
Why join Newmont?
At Newmont, our people are our strength and we’re committed to a safe, inclusive and supportive workplace. If you’re passionate about doing work that matters, join Newmont and help shape the future of mining.
Learn more about our purpose and values: About Newmont
Hear from our people: Life at Newmont
Important: Newmont does not ask candidates to pay money or share sensitive personal data outside our secure application process. If this happens, please report it to our Business Integrity team:
[email protected]
.
Apply

Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our maintenance team on site, the Crane Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of mobile or overhead cranes to lift, move, and position loads in accordance with lift plans, site procedures, and regulatory requirements. In this role ensures all lifting activities are conducted safely and collaboratively with rigging and ground crews, whilst observing and adhering to the workplace health & safety policies.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring that the sections daily work plans are executed as directed.
This position reports to the Supervisor FPM team accountable for providing effective operation of crane owned by K92 Mining.
Maintain good working relationship with colleague workers.
Responsible for housekeeping.
Operate cranes to lift and place materials safely and accurately.
Conduct pre-start inspections and report defects immediately.
Follow lift plans, load charts, and supervisor directions.
Work closely with riggers during lifts.
Establish and maintain safe exclusion zones when lifting.
Monitor load stability, weather conditions, and ground conditions.
Stop work when conditions become unsafe and notify supervisor.
Maintain accurate logbooks and equipment records.
Assist in crane setup, assembly, and dismantling as required.
Participate in JSAs/SOP’s, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
Shift work, overtime, and shutdowns may be required
Outdoor, site-based environments.
Exposure to weather, noise, and heavy machinery.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have all or some of the following
Experience in mining, heavy industry, or major infrastructure projects.
Minimum Grade eight (8) educational qualification, but preferable a Grade ten (10) certificate or PETT courses.
Valid PNG Class 7 driver’s licence
Working at Heights certification.
Proven crane operating experience.
Dogging or Rigging licence
A minimum number of years’ crane experience (e.g., 2–5 years) a prerequisite.
Ability to read and write both Pidgin and English
Strong understanding of crane operations and lifting principles.
Ability to interpret load charts and lifting diagrams.
Excellent situational awareness and hazard recognition.
Effective communication and teamwork.
Problem-solving during complex or changing lift conditions.
High attention to safety and detail.
Must have at least 5 or more years of truck driving.
Must be able to understand the company’s targets and work towards achieving the targets.
Have a strong understanding of the mining cycle.
Flexible, adaptable and be a strong and proactive team player.
Ability to meet agreed schedules and deadlines.
Ability to maintain good working relationships with other team members and K92 Mining Ltd employees.
Behaviour consistent with K92 Mining core values
Excellent problem solving and decision-making capability
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to communicate clearly with people at all levels of the organisation and engage all relevant stakeholders
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
